text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, today's dessert is buono too! Thank 
you for the me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Maya-chan? Why the big sigh? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Maya thinks she's gonna keep her 
distance from sweet treats for a while...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeh~!? No way, Maya-chan, didn't you 
like sweet things!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't say it! I still love it, but if I 
give in here, I'd fail as a mature woman!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even if a sweet dessert is waiting for me, 
even if it's fluffy carrot mousse... I'm 
holding off on sweets until I lose weight!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan... If that's how it is, leave it 
to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Soy milk pudding and agar jelly! 
These cookies are all low-calorie too~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Buono-chan, is all of this... for Maya?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just love seeing Maya eating a ton☆ Come 
on, let's eat together~!

It looks like Hishi Akebono switching to 
low-calorie sweets herself has paid off 
with her diet...!
